title: Loops and Graphs (@hanakoxbt)
description: Based on @hanakoxbt's Loops and Graphs architecture: split a feature into isolated test-first units, run bounded intra-node loops in parallel worktrees, merge deterministically, ship through one human gate, and feed lessons back to the splitter.
